# effect

In [EhOsContract.Contract](contract-dsl.md), section `contract`.

```elixir
effect name, label
```

A side effect on an event, outside the log.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-effect-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The effect's name. |
| <a id="contract-effect-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` | yes |  | What it does, as the business states it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-effect-handles"></a>`handles` | `atom \| list(atom)` | yes |  | The events it reacts to. |
| <a id="contract-effect-calls"></a>`calls` | `atom \| {atom, atom} \| list(atom \| {atom, atom})` |  | `[]` | The external systems it calls: `:p1`, or `{:p1, :submit_report}` naming one of the system's operations, which a system that declares operations requires. |
| <a id="contract-effect-delivery"></a>`delivery` | `:in_transaction \| :at_least_once` |  | `:at_least_once` | When it runs. |
| <a id="contract-effect-idempotency"></a>`idempotency` | `[key: atom, owner: :self \| :downstream \| :infrastructure]` |  |  | What makes a second delivery harmless, and who keeps it so: `[key: :event_id, owner: :self]`. |
| <a id="contract-effect-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the effect comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`constraint`](#contract-effect-constraint).

## effect.constraint
